filas.texto: If you are pursuing the super thick and destructive weapon, then you may be the future sword maker!
filas.pista: Obtain it by collecting the Earthquake Cardset.

filas.texto: If you are searching for the super long-reaching and puncturing weapon, then you may be the future spear maker!
filas.pista: Obtain it by collecting the Storm Cardset.

filas.texto: If you are exhuming the super far-reaching and exact weapon, then you may be the future bow maker!
filas.pista: Obtain it by collecting the Arc Cardset.

filas.texto: If you are questing for the super psychic and magic weapon, then you may be the future staff maker!
filas.pista: Obtain it by collecting the Wisdom Cardset.

filas.texto: He was a scientist who studied poisons, however, his head became poisoned and he became a propagator who likes casting poison
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Flamen Tomomy in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: The first impression he gives to others is one of rudeness. He likes to grow plants. But he often stamps on flowers and breaks bottles by accident.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Overlord Legte in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: A respectable craftsman should be strict on quality. After all, word of mouth can make or break his business.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by handing in Suft's orders of the Power Shield and the Level 7 Defense Fuel.(Have to trade with Suft Branch in the Palm Base)

filas.texto: He likes to do his thinking in a group of people.  Nobody knows what he is thinking, but when someone gets close to his idea, he will surely know.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Flower Monster in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: The lousy adhesive monster just keeps dividing itself more and more when you try to cut it.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Soul Slalin in the Magic Kichen Path.

filas.texto: Nalica waits in her deep slumber for a handsome prince to wake her with true loves kiss. However, most people shun her.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Sleeper Nalica in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: This is the habitat of a mysterious beast and attracts countless collectors. Take care while working, maybe the dream beast is behind you…..
filas.pista: You may obtain it by collecting the Dream Beast Den.

filas.texto: Your supply of products is admired by Suft C of C. Don't hesitate, you must deliver them as soon as there is an order.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by handing in Suft's order of the Holy Manteau.(Have to trade with Suft Branch in the Palm Base)

filas.texto: The Garden Elf who looks after the flowers flies like a butterfly. Strangely, all the flowers he takes care of have the tendancecy to bite people.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Garden Elf in the Mysterious Garden.

filas.texto: Without a nose, he is immune to his own smell. No one wants to be his friend. Anyone who comes too close to him will need to wash for hours.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Pupu Demon in the Gulp Room  and the Magic Kichen Path.

filas.texto: The Evil Eye will excrete colourful crystal when his stomach is too full. What precious waste!
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Evil Eye in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: The fish from the dangerous areas taste more delicious. Also, only the fisherman who can overcome such difficulties may obtain it.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by collecting white fish.

filas.texto: It is not easy to be so outstanding when you have so many orders. But it is good to be the largest supplier of Suft.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by handing in Suft's orders of the Black Sycee, the Beast Fell Strip, the Cherry Thread,the Shy Batten and the White Fish Meat.(Have to trade with Suft Branch in the Palm Base)

filas.texto: They often dance in a small group and dream of becoming stars. But their movements are too stiff and clunky.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Fire Mummy in the Gulp Room.

filas.texto: Bathing in chocolate is his way of keeping white. But it is dirty of him to get out without washing himself clean afterwards.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Injuried Angel in the Hell Palace.

filas.texto: Cherry Grass will produce a kind of fairy fruit when the world is in chaos. However, when the world is chaotic, is the fruit necessary?
filas.pista: You may obtain it by collecting Cherry Grass.

filas.texto: Suft C of C likes gifted craftsman. They send orders to the best craftsman. Not only for business, but also for selecting greatest of them.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by handing in Suft's orders of the Benison Ring and the Energy Boots.(Have to trade with Suft Branch in the Palm Base)

filas.texto: The Monk group made a ten-day benison ceremony on the top of the Crashing Hillock. They scattered the benison crystals all over.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by the advanced manufacturing Benison Rings.

filas.texto: Evil chef Berssif burned the fly's wings when he blew out his birthday candles. The poor fly could only walk sadly around.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Fire Fly in the Lava Cave, the Flaming Door, the Underground Square and the Hell Palace.

filas.texto: The Coward Mosi often attacks others hiding in groups. However, if he is caught he never confesses and escapes quickly.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Rat Mosi in the Magic Kichen Path.

filas.texto: Help the lovely girl to complete her wish.  Then look at her happy smile, it can make you happy as well.
filas.pista: The little girl on Shining Coast cannot find her beautiful shell. Please help her! (Related quest: Little girl's wish)

filas.texto: It is a kind of giant turtle, enjoying the sunshine. But be careful that you are not mistaken for a big stone.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Puqi Turtle on the Gold Beach.

filas.texto: Walking in the sun may have affected the shell of the Puqi Crab. It can be found due to the burning smell.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Puqi Crab on the Gold Beach.

filas.texto: He considers himself the host of the Gold Beach. He will jump out from behind rocks whenever a traveller goes by. What an annoying guy!
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Pontiff Hululu on the Gold Beach.

filas.texto: The old man on the dock regards you as the true guard of coast. How honorable of him!
filas.pista: The old man on Shining Coast sighs at the sight of the damaged environment, are you able to change the situation? (Related quest: Return my clean sea)

filas.texto: They stay on the west coast of the Puqi Island under the orders of the Pirate Captain. They often follow adventurers and rob them.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Puqi Pirate in the Shining Coast.

filas.texto: He is the leader of Puqi Pirates and has terrible bad breath. But all of the Puqi Pirates are loyal to him.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Puqi Pirate Leader in the Shining Coast.

filas.texto: The Coast Protector keeps people going to the other side of the sea. What secret does the remote side hold?
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Coast Protector in the Shining Coast.

filas.texto: Winning the trust of the Mermen is proof of courage and wisdom.
filas.pista: The Mermen of Dream Ocean have taken action! What could have worried them so much?

filas.texto: Promoted up from a Soldier Crab, it now wants to make it's mark as a General. Anyone who disobeys him is certain to be punished.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Crab General in the Shining Coast or the Colorful Coral Reefs.

filas.texto: Beat lover Octopus seems to be hard at work, but actually, it is destroying the bilge with it's beatings.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Wood Octopus in the Colorful Coral Reefs or the Dream Ocean.

filas.texto: Regardless of their odd appearance, team work is the mermans's biggest weapon. Don't fight them alone.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Leader Nio in the Blue Sea or the Dream Ocean.

filas.texto: We award you with this card in recognition of your determination and will for protecting the coral. May your persistence never end.
filas.pista: Don't think that Guang of the Puqi Village only eats chocolate. He also protects the coral.  And he pays a lot of attention to it. Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Displace coral reefs)

filas.texto: The Octopus wishes to practise his handwriting with his own ink. However, how can it write in the sea? No wonder he is scrawls on the faces of others.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Ink Octopus in the Colorful Coral Reefs or the Dream Ocean.

filas.texto: In florid coral sea, its colorful shell may be the best camouflage you have ever seen. Take care of yourself from it's invisible rapier!
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Whelk Swordsman in the Colorful Coral Reefs or the Wave Harbor.

filas.texto: He is the best at shooting. The resistance of seawater doesn't affect him at all. Good luck to his targets.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Sharp-shooter in the Colorful Coral Reefs.

filas.texto: The sea is once again pure and clean, thanks to your efforts, which also prove the scientific power of Iron Castle.
filas.pista: Ocean Scholar in the Palm Base wants to purify the sea. Please assist him! Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Eliminate impurity)

filas.texto: You want to help the Slow Grandpa, but he cannot stop chattering.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Whelk Mage in the Colorful Coral Reefs or the Wave Harbor.

filas.texto: How can they continue playing the bad jellyfish has stolen their beachball. He is so mean.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Ball Jellyfish in the Colorful Coral Reefs or the Wave Harbor.

filas.texto: He is well protected by slippery tentacles and sharp stings. Pay attention to them and be careful.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Stab Jellyfish in the Wave Harbor or the Blue Sea.

filas.texto: Once he joined a sword competition and came in last place because he got all tangled up.Then he formed the habit of beating people with his sword.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating the Sword Jellyfish in the Wave Harbor.

filas.texto: You are a kind man to help Teny use her skills. She will never forget you.
filas.pista: By mentioning the shell brooch, you can't help but praise Teny's skills. It is even more outstanding when matched with the scarf or the amice. Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Wandering Artist)

filas.texto: You are a kind man to help Teny use her handicraft. She will never forget you.
filas.pista: By mentioning of shell necklace, you can't help but praise Teny's skills. Only she could make such a delicate necklace. Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Wandering Artist)

filas.texto: You are a kind man to help Teny create her romance. She will never forget you.
filas.pista: How romantic the bracelet is! It being given as a love token is a wonderful thing. Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Wandering Artist)

filas.texto: You are a kind man to help Teny play to her creativity. She will never forget you.
filas.pista: Only Teny can create such wonderful handicraft. It is useful and beautiful. Girls love it very much. Repeatable quest. (Related quest: Wandering Artist)

filas.texto: The Top Pearl can only be found after spending a very long time in the sea.
filas.pista: Only in the deepest depths of the sea may the Top Pearl be found. The quantity left is so small.

filas.texto: Recently, the Mermen have become angry because more and more humans and Angels are traveling under the water. Because of this they are having to wash their hair and trim their nails more and more often.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Blue Mermen in the Blue Sea.

filas.texto: Although it is known as an Angel Fish, it doesn't really look like a fish.  This is because it was once a beautiful little Angel who was forced to live underwater for some past discretion. So now all of our angels are always on their best behavior.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Feather Angel Fish in the Blue Ocean, Sunken Ruins or Quiet Ocean.

filas.texto: The red teeth show that it is very poisonous. But don't be so scared of it; in fact the only thing it drinks is tomato juice.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Poison Evil Fish in the Sunken Ruins, Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: The poor Lantern Fish's lantern has been stolen. And now the poor thing must search through all of the rubbish on the sea bed to find it.  However, it is somewhat troubled by all of the congratulations it has been receiving from the other fish.  Why would they congratulate him?...
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Red Lantern Fish in the Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: The evil shark has equipped himself with many weapons and it is even holding a huge blade in its fin. Not as impressive as it seems as without fingers or opposable thumbs he keeps on dropping it!  It seems that he was left with no choice but to bite people.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Rage Sharks in the Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: The Evil Fish are some of the fastest swimmers in the sea. Even Poseidon likes to invite them to perform their synchronized swimming routines for him.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Evil Fish in the Sunken Ruins, Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: Because they want to build a base deep under the water, the Evil Lyceum has sent a group of explorers to search for a suitable spot.  Their leader is equipped the most advanced LED searchlight so that they can swim in the deepest darkest depths of the ocean to complete their mission.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Sea Explorers in the Quiet Ocean.

filas.texto: After training many seahorses go on to become people's favorite mounts. I know of a seahorse whose deepest desire is to join in the training.  So much so in fact it often tries to sneak away from it's owners farm in Palm Base. However, its owner always catches it before it can get too far.
filas.pista: The cattleman's beloved seahorse is missing. Please help him find it! You may find it if you repeatedly complete the race quest. (Related quest: The Seahorse Ran Away)

filas.texto: It is indeed a special starfish. It loves to watch TV but isn't always the most clever of animals. It's one distinctive feature is that unlike all other Starfish it has a nose.
filas.pista: The Little Star didn't watch TV at home. How can it do if it meets some evil fish. The Crab Boss hopes that you can get the Little Star back. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: The Lost Starfish)

filas.texto: The Evil Lyceum lied to them and told them that the Angel Lyceum had cancelled their International Ballroom Dance. That's why they decided to help the Evil Lyceum instead.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Scale Soldiers in the Lost Region.

filas.texto: As the elder, it is really skilled at dancing. It attracts a lot of innocent grannies because it always leans on it's stick and shakes its mantle whilst dancing.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Linberd Elders in the Evil Ship.

filas.texto: Hulio is the most knowledgeable Merman. Whenever any of the other Merpeople have a question they know that they can go to Hulio for the answer.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Merman Hulio in the Blue Sea or Dream Ocean.

filas.texto: His father loves to read Superman Comics, so much so that he named his only son Clark. However, Clark can't fly so he has to ride on an Evil Fish instead.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Knight Clarc in the Sunken Ruins.

filas.texto: That small ship has taken King Ruff around the world many times. Even though it is broken and has had to be repaired many times, King Ruff says that it is safe. So, trust him!
filas.pista: Ruff dreamed of one day becoming the king of the sea when he was younger. Now he is retired and nobody knows whether he really became the king or not. He left a boat and he would like to find a successor. You may obtain it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: King on the Sea)

filas.texto: It is said that he drowned because he was hoisting the sail whilst the deck was wet and slippy.  He lost his footing, became entangled in the ropes, fell into the dark ocean and drowned. His ghost can often be heard telling other sailors to mop the deck and keep it clean.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Death Sail in the Blue Ocean or Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: He was the 13th brother of Captain Huc. Although he was a captain, he did not live long enough to become a great one.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Captain Hack in the Quiet Ocean.

filas.texto: It is Raby's 48th pet. It always tries to fight for it's master's attention, because Raby still has a girlfriend and chooses to devote his time to her instead. However it is always mindful that there may be a 49th pet coming to take it's place.
filas.pista: No matter where you find the pet, you must return it to it's master. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: King on the Sea and Return the Seal)

filas.texto: It's the most popular creature in the ocean. You can often see it in the movies. It used to be very gentle but fame has gone to it's tiny brain. Now it thinks that it is always taking a screen test  it's constantly destroying ships and causing havoc.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Octopus Oliss in the Raging Reefs or Blue Ocean.

filas.texto: Without their boats, those sailors have nothing constructive to do to kill time. So they gossip with each other all the day and chase after Merman.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Death Sailors in the Blue Ocean, Coral Vale or Quiet Ocean.

filas.texto: It is a rare Angel Fish. It is hard for it to beat it's wings because it has been under the water for such a long time. Maybe this is the fate of Angels who are not careful.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Winged Fish in the Sunken Ruins, Quiet Ocean or Coral Vale.

filas.texto: As the last and the most powerful guardian of Atlantis, the Hicalu Ship 1 has the super mission of destroying every enemy who shows an interest in the Ancient Treasure.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Hicalu Ship 1 in the Lost Region.

filas.texto: The snake king loves to eat sheep. But there are no sheep in Hell, so it has chosen to try it's luckin Eden. However, it is confined to stay under the water. That's why it is always in such a bad mood.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Asharl in the Evil Ship.

filas.texto: These Beastman Soldiers have to find a piece of wood as a weapon because of the shortage of materials.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Beastman Soldiers in the Half-beast Hamlet.

filas.texto: The female orangutan always puts on a long face because it has to go out and find its mate with the baby orangutan in its arms. Oh, even the orangutan has an affair.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Orangutan Mothers in the Waterfall Camp.

filas.texto: This handsome bear is a popular TV show hero. It always says "you are dead…" and then laughs rolling on the floor. It always asks others that whether it is funny or not!
filas.pista: It is said that even the skilled warriors will watch the TV show on time. It is great if I can have the stage photo. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Warriors)

filas.texto: The heavy axe proves that you are a skilled warrior. It stands for power and honor. When you have it in your hands, you are not a newbie anymore.
filas.pista: You should finish some trials if you want to be a skilled warrior. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Warriors)

filas.texto: This superior flower elf dropped into a mud puddle by accident and was covered by dirty leaves.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Wistaria Elves in the Noisy Rain Forest.

filas.texto: This priest takes charge of praying for the Naga Tribe. He always eats the offering on the sly and says that "Naga is really my home."
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Naga Elder Priests in the Half-beast Hamlet.

filas.texto: Even her teacher always speaks loudly that she is really a beautiful girl. It is said that she has a lot of fans and this card is the certificate of the fans.
filas.pista: It is said that she is the best student in the Mage School in the history. You should train yourself if you would like to be as good as her. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Mages)

filas.texto: This unique staff proves that you are a skilled mage. The roses on it stand for the art and it seems that you are an artist when you wave the staff.
filas.pista: You should finish some trials if you want to be a skilled mage. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Mages)

filas.texto: The best sharpshooter can fly steadily in the sky. However, it can't fly far.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Bird Sharpshooters in the Giant Wooden Stairs.

filas.texto: It is said that it used to be a human being. However, he was too weak and everybody called him idiot.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Glede Buds in the Ancient Glide River.

filas.texto: This strange cactus can release a thousand needles at the same time. That's why a lot of bowmen admire it.
filas.pista: Only one person is still alive after he saw cactus monster's stance. He even took a photo. Where is he? You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Bowmen)

filas.texto: The long sharp bow proves that you are a skilled bowman. The spine stands for accuracy while the sharp blade is agility.
filas.pista: You should finish some trials if you want to be a skilled bowman. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Trial for Bowmen)

filas.texto: It is a professional killer among worms and is called as Death Killer. However, we always see that it is sent back on a stretcher.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Death Killer Camote in the Ancient Glide River.

filas.texto: These worms are noisy and they always wander here and there. However, the most depressed thing is that it is really difficult for you to understand what they are talking about.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Noisy Worms in the Noisy Rain Forest.

filas.texto: Do you feel that you are stared by many pairs of eyes when you pass through the jungle? In fact, these guys like to stay on a stone and stare at others with the eyes on their wings.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Giant Forest Moths in the Clouding Forest.

filas.texto: It is said that it has a thousand eyes. However, can you imagine that it has 500 pairs of glasses? Oh, my god!
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Hook Worm King in the Giant Wooden Stairs.

filas.texto: The crocodiles like to stay in the den. They always say that they like to attack travelers passing by. In fact, they are scared of the sunshine.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Den Crocodiles in the Secret Den.

filas.texto: It always considers itself as the most handsome worm in the world. But, it has a broken horn.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Iron-shell Worms in the Secret Den.

filas.texto: In order to feed themselves, they have to work as cleaners.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Blue Clapper Dragons in the Waterfall Camp.

filas.texto: The moth king accuses others all the time.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Moth King Turna in the Clouding Forest.

filas.texto: Take care of yourself. Mrs. Dorsa may bite you hanging on the ceiling.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Leech Mrs. Dorsa in the Secret Den.

filas.texto: The evil plant dreams to drink others' blood all the day. However, it is always hungry because it can't run fast.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Jade Bloody Flowers in the Noisy Rain Forest.

filas.texto: He used to be an Angel. After he betrayed the Archangel, he ran to the Cloud-top Land and became a demon. It is said that he has an affair with the wind king.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Bloody Saint Judas in the Cloud-top Land.

filas.texto: The legendary wolfman only appears at the full moon night. However, it always considers itself as an orc.
filas.pista: Some wolfmen have hurt people in the Aurora City…But they disappeared suddenly. Is there really a wolfman in the world? (Related quest: The Horrible Full Moon Night)

filas.texto: These kind-hearted fairies are born to protect the forest. However, nobody appreciates them and always asks them to put on their clothes. That's why they became angry and attack others.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Earth Fairies in the Waterfall Camp.

filas.texto: He is the leader of the Naga Tribe. However, there are still other leaders. It is nothing.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Naga Leader Arna in the Half-beast  Hamlet.

filas.texto: The forest is too vast and dangerous. People in Waterfall Camp have organized a Search Party to help travelers and the leader is a owl which can work at night.
filas.pista: The forest Search Party has quests now. Who is asking for help now? You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Rescue in the Woods)

filas.texto: As the orderly man of Breeze Woods, he is very proud of his flight skill. However, he is too fat to fly now because he has eaten too many cakes.
filas.pista: Orderly Man Dick needs someone to help him. Can you run fast? You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: A Dispatch from the Breeze Woods)

filas.texto: Lion Knights take charge of the security in Cloud-top Land. However, others always accuse them because they can fly but they ride on lions.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Lion Knights in the Cloud-top Land.

filas.texto: A butterfly soul has been sealed in the halberd.
filas.pista: The evil Sandman sealed a butterfly's soul in a weapon. Older Wal needs someone to help release the should. It is a really difficult quest. (Related quest: Life Seal).

filas.texto: A parrot soul has been sealed in the wand.
filas.pista: The evil Sandman sealed a parrot's soul in a weapon. Older Wal needs someone to help release the should. It is a really difficult quest. (Related quest: Life Seal).

filas.texto: An antelope soul has been sealed in the bow.
filas.pista: The evil Sandman sealed an antelope's soul in a weapon. Older Wal needs someone to help release the should. It is a really difficult quest. (Related quest: Life Seal).

filas.texto: Sleeper Sandman is the owner of the Limitless Tower. It is said that people will fall asleep once they look into Sandman's eyes. If Sandman opens his 6 eyes, people will die at once.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Sleeper Sandman in the Limitless Tower.

filas.texto: One of the most advanced machines in Eden which can work as fast as 100 miners. However, it is always stolen by adventurers.
filas.pista: Miners are too tired to digging any more. They hopes that they can find an easy way to do the job. You may find it if you repeatedly complete the quest. (Related quest: Work Overtime Again)

filas.texto: Every miner is digging and excellent miners can be awarded as Blago Warriors. However, what will they fight with?
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Blago Warriors in the Fantastic Sand City.

filas.texto: The worm is gentle. If you feed it something, it will help you dig the mine.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Desert Worms in the Desert Racetrack.

filas.texto: Anybody would like to buy this broken lamp?
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Blago Warriors or Blago Miners in the Fantastic Sand City.

filas.texto: The set is useful no matter you would like to dig mines or rob tombs. But I know you are a kind-hearted Angel.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Blago Warriors or Blago Miners in the Fantastic Sand City.

filas.texto: Since you have known Eilian's secret, why don't you love her more?
filas.pista: As Eilian's master, maybe you should take more care of her. (Related quest: Eilian's Story)

filas.texto: This beautiful girl is one of Eilian's friends. Eilain helped her find this job. However, it seems that she is not interested in it.
filas.pista: There are someone who serves the rich to bathe in the desert. What's going on? (Related quest: Good Friends Forever)

filas.texto: Soulmates will love each other more if they can sleep on this beautiful bed every day.
filas.pista: It is said that a merchant manufactured a luxurious bed for his beloved girl. But the result was not so happy. (Related quest: My Previous Master)

filas.texto: This small table is more durable than it looks.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by manufacturing a Khaki Round Table.

filas.texto: It seems that it wants people to fall asleep on this soft chair. Hey, we are not lazy!
filas.pista: You may obtain it by manufacturing a Yellow Striped Chair.

filas.texto: It is said that he can steal the shadow as well. Take care of your shadow when you meet him.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Robber Walter in the Ghost Village.

filas.texto: They give themselves up and keep eating because they always fail to rob others.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Fat Thief Jem in the Ghost Village.

filas.texto: In fact, it is not easy for Ali Bandits to rob others because they are too weak.
filas.pista: You may obtain it by defeating Ali Bandit in the Ghost Village.

filas.texto: It is well-known that cactus can deposit much water. That's why merchants sell cactus bags to players.

filas.pista: Defeat the Carpenter Piggy in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.nombre: Photo of the Brick House Assistant
filas.texto: As a senior teaching assistant in the bricklaying department, he's definitely one of the best at building houses.
filas.pista: Defeat Cole, the piggy boss in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Porker the Fourth's final project showcased his unique architectural vision with various techniques.
filas.pista: Porker the Fourth in Building Block City wants to know the secrets of other builders to become the greatest architect. Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: Highest Art Form)

filas.texto: Good Tools Make Good Work 1
filas.pista: Banpu, a soldier from Chocolate Village, needs a powerful weapon to become the next captain. Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: A Soldier's Equipment Set)

filas.texto: Good Tools Make Good Work 2
filas.pista: Banpu, a soldier from Chocolate Village, needs a cool cape to become the next captain. Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: A Soldier's Equipment Set)

filas.texto: Good Tools Make Good Work 3

filas.texto: A spear-wielding fruit soldier is no pushover. After all, "a longer spear means a stronger warrior."
filas.pista: Defeat the Fruit Spearman in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: A Fruit Soldier who isn't particularly skilled at anything, but can do everything. He's a practical Fruit Soldier!
filas.pista: Defeat the Fruit Soldier in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Being so young and naive, they are still a little shy around people.
filas.pista: Defeat the Little Strawberry in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The mature berry won't hide away shyly anymore. Instead, it will stand up to protect the other berries!
filas.pista: Defeat Strawberry Guard Maya in Berry Garden for a chance to obtain it.

filas.texto: Ruby's stunning alchemy mount, while incredibly cool, requires constant energy to exist.
filas.pista: Ruby, the apprentice from Chocolate Village has always dreamed of having a unique mount. Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: The Apprentice's Path)

filas.texto: Angus, a dedicated commander, personally oversees every aspect of the Poker Castle.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Angus, the plump lamp spirit in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: A lycanthrope, Arslan's obsession with magic and relentless pursuit of its mastery led him to learn dark magic.
filas.pista: Defeat Dark Tutor Aslander in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The famous mage of Building Block City, Cathy is a mysterious figure. Despite her magic mastery, she continues to learn.
filas.pista: Defeat Mage Cathy in Building Block City for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The adorable little witch is skilled at using fiery magic to drive away those who bother her with an embrace of flames.
filas.pista: Defeat the Flame Witch in Building Block City for a chance to get.

filas.texto: As thanks for aiding Didiro in gathering materials for his mech, a special photo of the completed mech is being shared.
filas.pista: Even idols have their troubles. Please go find Didiro in the Chocolate Forest and listen to his wish. Obtain the cards of the Flame Witch and the Witch of Earth, and give them to Didiro to accept the task. Complete the quest to get. (Related quest: Idol's Wish)

filas.texto: The sweet-smelling wild berries often lure unwary victims into their traps with their delicious aroma, only to rob them.
filas.pista: Defeat the Sweet Strawberry in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The adorable little witch creates earth magic-based pitfall traps, where she catches travelers and observes them.
filas.pista: Defeat the Earth Witch in Building Block City for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The new dress that Pado has been longing for is said to have the magical ability to make her figure appear more slender.
filas.pista: Pado, the wealthy tycoon of Mushroom Village, has always wanted to be thinner. He came up with an idea to lose weight by changing his clothes. Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: Paddy's Weight Loss Method)

filas.texto: The righteous dog swordsman, making a dashing entrance in a coat, is actually not very skilled with a sword!
filas.pista: Defeat the Dog Swordsman in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Russell's tall and slender figure is on display in his tight-fitting suit, but such a physique doesn't really suit him.
filas.pista: Defeat Guard Captain Russell in Building Block City for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Pado's exquisite figure, captured in the photo, is too beautiful to keep to myself. I want to make more copies!
filas.pista: Pado, the wealthy tycoon of Mushroom Village, has always wanted to be thinner. Rumor has it that he'll give a "surprise" to anyone who helps him! Exchange cards with Pado to get a reward. (Related quest: Paddy's Weight Loss Method)

filas.texto: The righteous canine pugilist, a deep student of boxing, can only be defeated with the command, "Shake!"
filas.pista: Defeat the Dog Fighter in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The brick soldier is always on the clock, patrolling Building Block City. He's a real workhorse.
filas.pista: Defeat the Toy Soldier in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The innocent and cheerful Lisa May admires her powerful enemy and grows towards that goal to become a powerful being.
filas.pista: Defeat Love Fighter Lisa in Fruit Gale Land for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The Hearts Spearmen of Poker City is the vanguard of the city. Invaders must pass through them to enter the castle.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Heart Poker Spearman in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Peo's nose grows without end unless he brags. Is his strange curse true?
filas.pista: Everyone knows that Peo Chocolate Village loves to boast. Should you believe him? Keep completing the quest to unlock it. (Related quest: King of Boasts)

filas.texto: The curious bunny opened the treasure box and was swallowed and trapped by the Mimic.
filas.pista: Defeat the Pink Bunny in Chocolate Village for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The cool-looking little hatchling's big wings are actually just for show. It can only fly by using balloons!
filas.pista: Defeat Hell Messenger Disco in Mushroom Village for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The cream spearman soldier who guards the Chocolate Forest has a layer upon layer of cream as his best protection!
filas.pista: Defeat the Black Forest Soldier in the Chocolate Forest for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Though she may seem careless, Red Riding Hood is always protected by her grandfather's watchful eye.
filas.pista: Red Riding Hood's grandpa is worried about her safety. He hopes someone can help clear the dangers on the road. If you're interested, go to the Berry Garden to find her! Complete the quest to get. (Related quest: Red Riding Hood's Adventure)

filas.texto: Help Red Riding Hood's grandpa clear the dangerous evidence.
filas.pista: Defeat the Apple Dwarf in Building Block City Outskirts for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Ike, a member of the Cream Lancers, becomes more dangerous as his cream coating wears off. Don't underestimate him.
filas.pista: Defeat Chief Cheese Warrior in Berry Garden for a chance to obtain it.

filas.texto: Jason is a highly skilled swordsman. It's said that even in the heat of battle, he can keep the strawberry on his head!
filas.pista: Defeat Sandwich Warrior Jasson in Chocolate Village for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The Club Spearmen guard Poker City together with the Hearts Spearmen, but unlike the Hearts, they are better at defense.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Club Poker Spearman in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The Spade Poker Priest, the highest-ranking soldier, commands the troops and oversees city rituals.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Spade Poker Priest in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The eldest Norn, Urd, is the Norn of the past, her gaze forever fixed on the bygone days.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Goddess Ward in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Verdandi, the Norn of the present, is a vibrant and curious goddess.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Goddess Aglaia in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: Skuld, the youngest of the Norns, is the guardian of the future. With youthful optimism, she gazes towards tomorrow.
filas.pista: Clear Instance: Goddess Thalia in Poker Castle for a chance to get.

filas.texto: The Demon Queen, tasked by Lucifer to disrupt the flow of time, is really just a loud, temperamental woman.
